name: robot3d
description: Robot 3D: un disegno a mano diventa un videogioco (Three.js, geometria procedurale)

scripts.check: node --check robot.js && node --check robot-actions.js && node --check site.js
scripts.check:hygiene: tsc -p tsconfig.hygiene.json && node --test scripts/check-repository-hygiene_test.ts && node scripts/check-repository-hygiene.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.3 pages deploy dist --project-name robot3d --branch main
